# zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification — `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`)

> Public RFC `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`, Tier F): an honest, capped Tapscript `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM federated Bitcoin peg issuing 1:1 feeless `zBTC` on Zenon's block-lattice via tranche-isolated `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` + lightweight `SettlementContract`, verified by direct-on-L1 trimmed Bitcoin SPV + `k`-of-`n` federation co-signatures, paired with peg-free PTLC adaptor swaps and Lightning submarine-swap gateways. Supersedes archived `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`, preserved byte-for-byte under `versions/v0/`).

- **Current Version:** `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`) — pre-implementation RFC open for independent custody/HSM & bridge review (**M-15**). NOT mainnet-active.
- **Archived Version:** `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`, commit `7b47b8c`, superseded — do not implement): https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/v0/
- **Changelog & Diffs (`v0 → v1`):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/changelog/
- **Canonical Web Site:** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/btc-moonshot/spec
- **Single-Fetch Full Bundle (`v1`):** https://btc-moonshot.github.io/spec/llms-full.txt
- **Consistency & Bounds Checker:** `python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`

Epoch-averaged slashable/beacon U2 committee (`H-1`), `<21` Pillar fallback & competing certified branches (`L-1`), quorum-only impairment (`N-1`), mandatory bountied epoch handoff anchoring & mobile header sources (`H-7`). # zBTC: Bitcoin–Zenon Interoperability Protocol Specification

**Version:** `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc` — Tier F Honest Capped Federated Custody + Direct-on-L1 Trimmed SPV; supersedes archived `v0` / `v2.5.0-rfc`, see [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md))  
**Status:** Public Request for Comment (`v1` / `v3.0.0-rfc`) — NOT mainnet-active; gated on independent custody/HSM & bridge review (**M-15**), upstream `go-zenon` release & issue `#239` closure (**B1**), Signet drills, and governance decentralization (§7).  
**Target Networks:** Bitcoin Mainnet (`bip-0340`/`bip-0341`/`bip-0342` Taproot `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM federation) ↔ Zenon Network (`go-zenon` first tagged release containing `0aa299e` with `DynamicPlasmaSpork` enforced; legacy `v0.0.10` `e8986a6` reference only)  
**Consistency & Bounds Checker:** All modeled Tapscript input weights, BIP-68 CSV refresh margins, direct-on-L1 SPV ABI & Dynamic Plasma floor bounds, PTLC/HTLC timelocks, halving-indexed `K`, and a 2,000-step randomized simulation of the signer backing/conservation invariant are asserted by [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](./scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py) (`python3 -I scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`). *This script verifies internal mathematical consistency against explicitly labeled `SOURCED_` and `POLICY_` inputs; it is not an empirical Signet benchmark or audit.*

**Upstream Provenance & Review Trail:**
- Vision Proposal: [`https://btc-moonshot.github.io/bigidea/`](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/bigidea/) *(see §8 for required claims alignment)*
- Reference Node Codebase: [`go-zenon`](https://github.com/zenon-network/go-zenon) (`origin/dev` pinned at `770e893` for verified code anchors, `release/0.0.11-rc2` `b85ee94` + fix `0aa299e`)
- Archived Baseline (`v0` / `v2.5.0-rfc`): Frozen byte-for-byte in [`versions/v0/`](./versions/v0/) (SHA-256 verified in CI).
- Consolidated Hostile Review (`R7`): [`reviews/HOSTILE_REVIEW_R7_CONSOLIDATED.md`](./reviews/HOSTILE_REVIEW_R7_CONSOLIDATED.md) — every finding `C-1..C-4`, `H-1..H-8`, `M-1..M-15`, `L-1..L-4`, plus audit discoveries `N-1..N-6` and convergence blockers `B1..B5`, is dispositioned in [`CHANGELOG.md`](./CHANGELOG.md).

## 1. Executive Summary & Architectural Pivot (`v0` → `v1`)

This specification defines **`Tier F` (`BTC-CUSTODY-F1`)**: an **honest, capped federated Bitcoin peg** issuing 1:1 `zBTC` (`1 base unit = 1 satoshi`, 8 decimals, `21,000,000 BTC` max token cap, Stage 1B policy cap **`5.0 BTC`**) on Zenon's feeless block-lattice, verified by **direct-on-L1 trimmed Bitcoin SPV + `k`-of-`n` federation co-signatures**, paired with **peg-free PTLC adaptor swaps and Lightning Network submarine-swap gateways**.

**Why `v1` replaces `v0`'s BitVM2 hybrid:** The consolidated hostile review of `v0` (`v2.5.0-rfc`) and independent peer review established four fundamental blockers in the `v0` hybrid: (1) ZNN's thin market liquidity (`400k–727k ZNN/BTC` vs assumed `10,500 ZNN/BTC`) cannot economically secure a 15 BTC pilot via Pillar slashing (**C-1**); (2) trusting committee-signed canonical Zenon state makes unchallenged optimistic batches, spork upgrades, and free-delegation committees fatal (**C-2, H-1, H-2, H-3**); (3) published Groth16 BitVM2 assert sizes (~1–4.8 MB) are 4–10× larger than `v0`'s assumed `220 kvB`, breaking bond/watcher economics (**C-3, H-4, M-6**); and (4) rotating 30-day committee roots forced an un-deleted `N`-of-`N` `Q_graph` key (plus an `N`-of-`N` `CommitteeIdentityKey`), creating both custodial sweep risk and 1-of-`N` permanent bricking (**C-4, N-2**).

**What `v1` is, stated plainly:**
- **Custody:** A `k`-of-`n` Tapscript `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM federation (`7-of-10` pilot / `11-of-15` scaled) under a NUMS internal key, with an explicit custodial `<52,560> OP_CSV` (~365-day) backup recovery leaf and mandatory on-chain vault refresh every `26,280` blocks (~182.5 days). **No BitVM2, no operators/fronting slots, and ZERO ZNN in the Bitcoin safety path.**
- **Mint & Burn Settlement:** Direct-on-L1 trimmed Bitcoin SPV inside `SettlementContract` (no optimistic batches, no 48h challenge lag, no executors) co-signed by `≥ k` federation signers, with `SettlementContract`'s exposure isolated behind a timelocked `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` (**H-8, B3c**).
- **Signer Firewall & Conservation:** At least two independent signer implementations independently check a strict VM-balance conservation invariant (**B3a/B3b**) and a pinned `settlementCodeHash` firewall (**H-3**) before signing any Bitcoin spend.
- **No Timeout-Only Refunds:** Signed Bitcoin payouts never expire; peg-out refunds require a K-deep Bitcoin SPV **proof of conflict** (`SubmitConflictRefundProof`) against a Zenon-final `BatchIntent` (**B4**).
- **Trust-Minimized Future (`v2`):** Deleted-key non-expiring BitVM / garbled circuits + ZK execution validity proofs + Bitcoin-anchored full-node fork choice are preserved honestly as a **non-normative `v2` Research Annex** in [`spec/01 Appendix A`](./spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md#appendix-a-non-normative-v2-research-annex-path-a-trust-minimized-bitvm) gated on Research Gates **R-1..R-8**.

Any Zenon contract behavior that conflicts with Part 1 is a spec bug, and honest signers MUST refuse to sign.

## 3. End-to-End Protocol Flows (`Tier F`)

### 3.1 Peg-In: BTC → Tweaked Vault Deposit → Sweep → Direct-L1 SPV Mint

1. **Capacity Reservation (`M-7`):** Before sending BTC, user (or relayer) calls `SettlementContract.ReserveMintCapacity(depositOutpoint_or_commitment, expectedAmountSats, zenonRecipient)` to verify `Circ + PendingForeignRelease + ActiveReservations + expectedAmountSats <= ActiveCap` and `Status == ACTIVE` (`Halted == 0`). Reservations expire automatically after `288` Bitcoin blocks if unused.
2. **Provisional Tweaked Deposit Address:** User derives a per-recipient Taproot deposit address using the active federation vault policy under a deterministic NUMS tweak `H_NUMS + H("zBTC/DepositTweak/v2", zenonRecipient || refundPk) * G`:
   - **Leaf 1 (Active Federation):** `k`-of-`n` `OP_CHECKSIGADD` (`7-of-10` pilot / `11-of-15` scaled).
   - **Leaf 2 (Depositor Refund, `M-7`):** `<288> OP_CSV OP_DROP <refundPk> OP_CHECKSIG` (~48h, `>> K_pilot = 14`).
   User sends any amount `>= 100,000` sats (`0.001 BTC`) plus peg-in consolidation fee `>= ceil(input_vb * r_ref)` (`25,850` sats for `7-of-10` / `36,625` sats for `11-of-15` at `r_ref = 100 sat/vB`).
3. **Federation Sweep:** After deposit confirms (and strictly before `h_dep + 200`, leaving an `>= 88`-block safety buffer before Leaf 2 unlocks), `>= k` signers independently verify the Zenon capacity reservation and sign a batched `SweepTx` (`stripped size <= 6,144 B`) consolidating deposits into standard `BTC-CUSTODY-F1` vault UTXOs (respecting `MaxVaultUtxos = 64`). If capacity was exhausted or the federation is paused, the federation does NOT sweep and the user recovers unconditionally via Leaf 2 after `288` blocks.
4. **Direct-on-L1 SPV Mint (`SubmitSweepLockProof`):** Once `SweepTx` reaches `K_pilot = 14` confirmations, anyone submits `SubmitHeaderBatch` + `SubmitSweepLockProof(strippedSweepTx, blockHash, txIdx, txBranch, cbMidstateProof, mintAllocations[], fedSigs[>=k])` directly to `SettlementContract` (no 48h batch delay). On-chain `btcspv` verifies `K`-deep Bitcoin inclusion, CVE-2017-12842 coinbase midstate (`len != 64`), `sum(mintAllocations) <= sum(vaultOutputs) - minPegInFees`, deposit-outpoint replay uniqueness, and `>= k` independent federation signatures attesting recipient attribution (auditable off-chain via Taproot sighash input amounts). `SettlementContract` atomically transfers `netAmount` `zBTC` from its cap-bounded tranche to each `zenonRecipient`.

### 3.2 Feeless `zBTC` Transfers on Zenon Block-Lattice (`M-9`, `M-10`)

Standard `zBTC` transfers cost **0 satoshis BTC fee** and `21,000` base Plasma per account block (`42,000` Plasma total for send + receive), funded via refundable QSR fusion (`10 QSR` per block at floor price `1,000`) or SHA3-256 PoW (`31.5M` expected hashes per block at floor price; ~0.1–0.3s desktop, ~2–10s mobile/WASM). Under Dynamic Plasma at observed mainnet Momentum intervals of **`~11.4s`** (`origin/dev:vm/embedded/definition/spork.go`):
- Pinned `v1` spork floor (`2,100,000` Plasma/Momentum): `100` base blocks/Momentum (`~4.4` full send+receive transfers/s).
- Default (`4,200,000` Plasma/Momentum): `200` base blocks/Momentum (`~8.8` full transfers/s).
- Hard protocol ceiling (`2,100,000,000` Plasma/Momentum): `100,000` base blocks/Momentum (`~4,386` full transfers/s).

### 3.3 Peg-Out: Burn → `BatchIntent` → Dual-Implementation Signer Firewall → Payout or Conflict Refund (`B3a`, `B4`)

1. **`RequestPegOut(recipientScriptPubKey, grossAmountSats, maxUserFeeSats)`** *(ALWAYS open, even while `Halted == 1`)*: User sends `grossAmountSats >= 100,000` sats of `zBTC` to `SettlementContract` (which returns `zBTC` to `SettlementContract`'s tranche, decrements `RepresentationOutstanding`, and increments `PendingForeignRelease`). User's `maxUserFeeSats` covers their share of the Bitcoin payout fee.
2. **Zenon-Final `BatchIntent` (`B4`):** After peg-out burns reach `D_znn >= 60` Momentums depth (`~11.4` min at `11.4s`/Momentum; `2x` `protocol/chain_bridge.go:293`'s 30-Momentum rollback limit), federation coordinators post `PostBatchIntent(intentId, inputs[], outputs[(outboxId, spk, netSats)], feeCapSats, fedSigs[>=k])` on Zenon. `BatchIntent` MUST itself reach `D_znn >= 60` Momentums before ANY signer signs the Bitcoin payout transaction. All RBF fee-bump variants MUST spend the **identical `inputs[]` set**.
3. **Independent Signer Verification (`B3a/B3b` + `H-3` Firewall):** Each signer independently queries its own `bitcoind` (at a single `K`-deep snapshot) and its own pinned `go-zenon` node (at a single `D_znn`-final snapshot, with `>= k` independent signer nodes agreeing on the Momentum hash), verifies the pinned `settlementCodeHash` firewall, checks `Circ == RepresentationOutstanding` from VM balances (`B3b`), verifies the **B3a** conservation inequality across all signed in-flight batches + the new batch, checks the 24h payout rate limit, and only then signs its `OP_CHECKSIGADD` share.
4. **Completion (`SubmitReleaseProof`) or Conflict Refund (`SubmitConflictRefundProof`, `B4`):**
   - Once the Bitcoin payout confirms to `K = 14`, anyone calls `SubmitReleaseProof` (no upper deadline!) to mark each `outboxId` `RELEASED` and decrement `PendingForeignRelease`.
   - **No timeout-only refunds:** Because signed Bitcoin transactions never expire, a peg-out can ONLY be refunded via `SubmitConflictRefundProof`, which proves a `K`-deep Bitcoin transaction spent one of the `BatchIntent`'s inputs *without* paying `outboxId` (e.g., a federation cancel/refresh tx). If the federation dies permanently, unpaid peg-outs become Wind-Down claims at their gross amount (`spec/01 §5`).

### 3.4 Peg-Free Atomic Swaps & Lightning Gateway (`M-4`)

Specified in [`spec/03 §5`](./spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md#5-peg-free-atomic-swaps--lightning-submarine-swap-gateway):
- **PTLC Taproot MuSig2 Adaptor Swaps (BIP-327):** Bitcoin refund leaf `<72> OP_CSV`, Bob's claim MUST confirm by `h_conf + 66` (with CPFP anchor), Alice must release adaptor partial sig within `6` blocks of Zenon PTLC confirmation or Bob aborts, `T_btc_worst = 86,400s` (24h at `2.0x` slow blocks), `T_znn >= 108,000s` (30h / `~9,474` Momentums).
- **HTLC / Lightning Submarine-Swap Gateway:** `hashType = 1` (`HashTypeSHA256`), numeric `Δ_safety = 36` Bitcoin blocks (`CLTV >= now + 72` blocks on inbound Hold Invoices), per-peer rate limits (`<= 5` pending / `<= 0.1 BTC`, 5-minute cancel TTL). *Note: swaps are atomic, but the `zBTC` received remains a claim on the Tier F federation vaults.*

---

## 4. Honest Threat Model & Privileged Powers Table (`H-3`, `H-5`, `H-7`, `C-4`)

**`v1` (`Tier F`) is an honest, capped federated peg — NOT trustless BitVM.** Security is bounded by the following explicit trust assumptions:

1. **Federation Custody Safety (`k`-of-`n`, e.g., `7-of-10` pilot / `11-of-15` scaled):** Any `k` colluding active signers (or compromise of `k` HSMs) can steal all BTC in active vaults.
2. **Federation Liveness (`n - k + 1` offline):** If `>= n - k + 1` active signers go offline permanently, peg-in sweeps and normal peg-out exits freeze until the backup recovery leaf matures (`52,560` blocks / ~365 days).
3. **Recovery Set Trust (`k'`-of-`n'` after `52,560` blocks):** Once a vault UTXO ages past `52,560` blocks without refresh, the custodial backup recovery set can spend it and race the active set. **Timely on-chain vault refresh (`26,280` blocks / alert at `39,420`) is a safety duty, not hygiene.**
4. **Zenon Finality Depth, Liveness & Censorship:** Signers rely on `D_znn = 60` Momentum depth (`2x` `go-zenon`'s 30-Momentum rollback limit) and `>= k` independent signer nodes agreeing on the Momentum hash. Sustained Zenon halts or censorship delay minting, `BatchIntent` posting, and peg-outs, but cannot forge BTC spends past signer `B3a/B3b` checks. **ZNN's market price is NOT in `v1` BTC safety; it affects only Zenon economic liveness.**
5. **Upgrade Authority & Code-Hash Firewall:** Anyone controlling Zenon spork keys can alter `SettlementContract` code and mint unbacked `zBTC` on Zenon. Signers' pinned `settlementCodeHash` firewall and `B3b` VM-balance check stop unbacked `zBTC` from draining Bitcoin vaults through peg-outs, **but cannot stop an attacker from selling unbacked `zBTC` over PTLC/LN swaps before the halt is public.**
6. **SPV Header Relayer Liveness:** At least one relayer (including the federation itself) submits `SubmitHeaderBatch` so direct-on-L1 SPV tracks the canonical Bitcoin tip.
7. **Swap Timing & Bitcoin Fee/Block Envelope:** PTLC/LN users assume Bitcoin block confirmation within the `72`-block / `36`-block safety windows using CPFP fee bumping.

### 4.1 Complete Privileged Powers Table (`H-3` Closed)

| Power / Action | Holder (Today vs Stage 1B) | Threshold | Timelock | Maximum Effect / Blast Radius |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Create / Activate Protocol Sporks** (`CreateSpork`, `ActivateSpork`) | **Today:** `types.SporkAddress` (`z1qpxsw...`, unlimited) OR `types.CommunitySporkAddress` (`z1qqvwz...`, Mariposa01 Pillar, renewal window heights `14,567,887–19,791,986` ≈ Nov 2026–Sep 2028, `dev:vm/embedded/definition/spork.go:46-73`). **Stage 1B Hard Gate:** Replaced by `GovernanceContract` (`U5`). | Today: `1-of-1` single key (blocks Stage 1B). Stage 1B: Pillar governance vote + `>= k` federation co-sign for custody changes. | Custody-relevant sporks: **`>= 30 days`** (min `SporkMinHeightDelay = 6` Momentums at node layer). | Can change `SettlementContract` consensus code and mint unbacked `zBTC` on Zenon; **blocked from draining BTC vaults** by signers' pinned `settlementCodeHash` firewall & `B3b` check (until `>= k` signer operators explicitly re-pin). |
| **Modify Dynamic Plasma Variables** (`SetPlasmaVariables`) | Same two spork keys today; `GovernanceContract` in Stage 1B. | Same as above. | Governance timelock (`>= 48h`); **cannot breach `v1` spork-pinned floor `MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum >= 2,100,000`** (`B2`). | Can raise Plasma fees / lower throughput down to pinned `2.1M` floor (`~4.4` transfers/s, `3` max-SPV calls/Momentum); cannot lock out SPV proofs. |
| **Active Vault Spend & Peg-In Attestation** | Independent Federation Signers (published identities, jurisdictions, HSM attestations). | `k`-of-`n` (`7-of-10` pilot / `11-of-15` scaled). | None (rate-limited per 24h in signer policy). | Full custody of active vault BTC; mint attribution on sweeps (bounded on-chain by sweep vault outputs). |
| **Backup Recovery Vault Spend** | Independent Recovery Signer Set (distinct keys/jurisdictions from active quorum). | `k'`-of-`n'` (e.g., `5-of-7`). | **`52,560` Bitcoin blocks** (~365 days `OP_CSV`) per unrefreshed UTXO. | Can spend any unrefreshed vault UTXO once CSV matures; races active set if refresh fails. |
| **Re-pin `settlementCodeHash` Firewall** | Federation Signer Operators (out-of-band configuration update). | `>= k` signer operators independently upgrading & re-pinning. | After `>= 30-day` upgrade notice & audit. | Authorizes signers to accept peg-outs from upgraded `SettlementContract` release/spork set. |
| **Release Cap Tranche (`TreasuryTrancheEscrow` → `SettlementContract`)** | `GovernanceContract` (`U5`) + `>= k` Federation Co-Sign. | Governance supermajority + `>= k` federation. | **`>= 14 days`** timelock. | Raises `SettlementContract`'s available `zBTC` tranche up to new `MaxRepresentationSupply` cap (Stage 1B starts at `5.0 BTC`). |
| **Add / Migrate Chain Binding (`AddBinding`)** | `GovernanceContract` (`U5`) + `>= k` Federation Co-Sign. | Governance supermajority + `>= k` federation. | **`>= 14 days`** timelock. | Registers new vault script / federation signer set for on-chain migration. |
| **Emergency Pause / Lower Cap (`GuardianPause`)** | `MultisigContract` (`U5`, e.g. `5-of-9` Ed25519 Guardians). | `M`-of-`N` (`5-of-9`). | Immediate (**narrowing only**). | Freezes new mints (`Halted = 1` / cap lower); **NEVER blocks `RequestPegOut` or honest signer payouts.** |
| **Un-Halt / Resume Minting (`ResumeMinting`)** | `GovernanceContract` (`U5`) + `>= k` Federation Signers. | Governance supermajority + `>= k` federation. | **`>= 48 hours`** timelock after incident snapshot & Proof-of-Reserves reconciliation. | Re-enables `ReserveMintCapacity` and `SubmitSweepLockProof`. |

## 5. Reference `go-zenon` Ground-Truth Baseline (`M-3`, `B1`, `B2`, `L-3`)

- **Normative U0 Target:** The **first tagged `go-zenon` release containing commit `0aa299e`** (which fixes `release/0.0.11-rc2` `b85ee94`'s regression `ad3b729` skipping post-VM hash verification on mutated embedded send blocks; parent of `0aa299e` is `b85ee94`). Neither `rc1` (`f19955f`) nor `rc2` (`b85ee94`) is a valid U0 baseline. Legacy `v0.0.10` (`e8986a6`) is reference only.
- **Hard U3 Preconditions:** (1) `DynamicPlasmaSpork` MUST be enforced prior to activating `MintedZbtcSpork` (**L-3, B2**); (2) upstream `go-zenon` issue `#239` (embedded receive failure provenance) MUST be closed with deterministic failed-receive guarantees (**B1**); (3) all code citations in [`spec/05`](./spec/05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md) are verified by symbol and content hash in CI.

## 7. Phased Delivery & Blocking Stage Gates (`M-15`)

| Stage | Scope | Mandatory Blocking Exit Criteria |
|---|---|---|
| **Stage 0 (Engineering & Signet Conformance)** | Ship U0 (`go-zenon` tag containing `0aa299e`, `DynamicPlasmaSpork` enforced); close `#239` (**B1**); build lightweight `SettlementContract` + `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` + panic-recovered direct L1 `btcspv` + `MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum >= 2.1M` floor (**B2**); build **two independent federation signer implementations**; run HSM key ceremony with published attestations. | Fuzz gate proving zero internal errors / FIFO receive stalls across all Settlement methods (**B1**); unit tests for `IssueMinted -> TreasuryTrancheEscrow -> SettlementContract` tranche isolation (**H-8, G-11**); end-to-end Signet drill *(labeled SPV conformance-only)* covering deposit, sweep, mint, `BatchIntent`, payout, RBF fee-bump, conflict cancel + refund (**B4**), vault refresh, recovery-leaf drill, signer-set migration, and a test proving signers **refuse** when `B3a/B3b` or `settlementCodeHash` fails; Signet↔Zenon PTLC/LN adversarial suite (**M-4, G-18**). |
| **Stage 1A (Mainnet Shadow)** | Deploy `SettlementContract` in `PAUSED` mode (`SubmitHeaderBatch` live; mints/peg-outs disabled); run federation nodes and live Proof-of-Reserves feed on Bitcoin mainnet. | `>= 30` consecutive days uninterrupted mainnet header/retarget tracking and PoR reconciliation with zero signer divergence. |
| **Stage 1B (Capped Federated Pilot — `<= 5.0 BTC`)** | Deploy `GovernanceContract` + `MultisigContract` (`U5`, zero single-key `SporkAddress`); publish seeded `>= 0.50 BTC` Operations/Surplus Reserve; obtain **independent third-party custody/HSM and bridge security review** with all blocking findings closed (**M-15**). | Unpause with policy cap `<= 5.0 BTC`, `7-of-10` HSM active set, `52,560`-block recovery leaf, `MaxVaultUtxos = 64`, `K_pilot = 14`, `D_znn = 60` Momentums; live peg-in, feeless transfer, batched peg-out, and PoR verified with zero `B3a/B3b` drift. |
| **Stage 2 (`v2` Research Track — Non-Normative)** | Trust-minimized deleted-key BitVM / garbled circuits + ZK execution validity + Bitcoin-anchored fork choice. | Strictly gated on completing Research Gates **R-1 through R-8** in [`spec/01 Appendix A`](./spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md#appendix-a-non-normative-v2-research-annex-path-a-trust-minimized-bitvm). |

## 8. Public Claims Alignment (`bigidea` Synchronization)

All public materials (including [`btc-moonshot.github.io/bigidea`](https://btc-moonshot.github.io/bigidea/)) MUST be updated to match `v1` verbatim:

| Outdated Public Claim (`v0` / `bigidea`) | Accurate `v1` (`v3.0.0-rfc`) Statement |
|---|---|
| "The network never holds a pooled key" | **`v1` uses an explicit `k`-of-`n` Tapscript `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM federation (`7-of-10` / `11-of-15`) plus a `52,560`-block custodial recovery leaf.** Trust-minimized deleted-key BitVM is a `v2` research target (Annex A). |
| "One honest watcher can stop a bad payout" | **Not applicable in `v1`** (no BitVM2 challenge game). Safety rests on `k`-of-`n` independent HSM signers running dual implementations with `B3a/B3b` conservation and `settlementCodeHash` checks. |
| Proofs "end at Bitcoin's proof-of-work" | In `v1`, peg-in/peg-out inclusion is verified by Bitcoin PoW SPV (`K = 14`), while custody and sweep attribution are authorized by the `k`-of-`n` federation. In Zenon light clients (`spec/04`), validity comes from a 21-of-30 BLS committee and Bitcoin provides timestamp ordering. |
| "Security is funded by the network's own staking token" | **False for `v1` BTC custody.** ZNN's price is NOT in `v1` BTC safety; it affects only Zenon economic liveness. |
| "Millions of transactions per second"; per-second streams | Zenon Dynamic Plasma provides `~8.8` full send+receive transfers/s at default (`4.2M`), `~4.4` tx/s at the `v1` pinned floor (`2.1M`), and `~4,386` tx/s at the hard protocol ceiling (`2.1B`) at `11.4s`/Momentum; mobile PoW takes `~2–10s`/block. |
| Spam multiplier "0.5–5×" | **Removed** — does not exist in `go-zenon` code; Dynamic Plasma resource prices adjust up to `MaxPriceChangePercent` per Momentum with a `1,000` floor and no ceiling. |
| "0 satoshi fees" | **0 BTC fees for `zBTC` transfers on Zenon only** (requiring refundable fused QSR or SHA3-256 PoW). Peg-ins and peg-outs pay Bitcoin network & consolidation fees. |
| "Peg-free, zero vault trust swaps" | PTLC/LN swaps are atomic with zero intermediary theft risk during the swap, **but the `zBTC` received remains a claim on the Tier F federation vaults.** |
| "Oracle verified" | **Consistency-checked** via `scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py` against sourced/policy inputs; not empirically audited until Stage 0/1B gates pass. |
| Omission of Zenon / ZNN / QSR / Pillars | Public pages MUST explicitly name **Zenon Network, ZNN, QSR, and Pillars**. |

---

## 9. Written Answers to Hostile Review Questions

Every question posed by the consolidated hostile review (`R7`) is answered normatively here:

- **C-1 (ZNN/BTC forging price):** *Not applicable in `v1`.* ZNN is removed from BTC custody safety; the `10,500 ZNN/BTC` assumption is deleted. Stage 1B cap (`5.0 BTC`) is policy-set. See Annex A Gate **R-1/R-2** for `v2`.
- **C-2 (Fake `FOREIGN_RELEASE` in unchallenged batch):** *Closed by removal in `v1`.* Optimistic batches are deleted; payouts require `>= k` independent HSM signers checking `D_znn = 60`-final Zenon burns, `B3a/B3b` VM balances, and `settlementCodeHash`. See Annex A Gates **R-1/R-3** for `v2`.
- **C-3 (Measured BitVM2 assert/disprove sizes & standardness):** *Not applicable in `v1`.* BitVM2 is moved to Annex A Gate **R-4** (requiring measured Signet sizes across BitVM2 and garbled circuits before `v2`).
- **C-4 (Why `Q_graph` was never deleted & key-loss impact):** *Resolved in `v1`.* `v0`'s never-deleted `N`-of-`N` `Q_graph` (and `N`-of-`N` `CommitteeIdentityKey`) is replaced by a `k`-of-`n` `OP_CHECKSIGADD` HSM federation tolerant of `n - k` key losses + a `52,560`-block recovery leaf. Deleted-key non-expiring graphs are Annex A Gate **R-6**.
- **H-1 (Why delegated stake at one snapshot):** *Fixed in `spec/04 §3.1`.* Decoupled from `v1` BTC custody; Zenon U2 committee selection now uses epoch-averaged variable slashable stake or beacon-randomized selection (never free instant delegation or fixed self-bond tie-break).
- **H-3 (Complete privileged-powers list & Pillar upgrade threshold):** Answered in **§4.1** above. Single-key spork authority blocks Stage 1B; custody upgrades require `>= 30-day` timelock + `>= k` federation signer firewall re-pinning.
- **H-4 (Watcher capital & front-running):** *Not applicable in `v1`.* Moved to Annex A Gate **R-5**.
- **H-5 (100% exit time & liquidity):** *Resolved in `v1`.* No serial fronting lanes or 5.5-day cooldowns; the federation batch-pays directly from confirmed vaults (`<= 64` UTXOs), limited only by signer 24h velocity limits and Bitcoin block space (`<= 1–3` days for 100% of a `5.0 BTC` pilot cap under normal conditions).
- **H-6 (April 2024 fees & June 2021 slow blocks):** *Resolved in `v1`.* No 46d/56d/58d CLTV cliff; recovery CSV is `52,560` blocks (~365d) with `13,140`-block (~91d) alert margin, Operations Reserve is sized for `2,000 sat/vB` across all `64` vault UTXOs, and PTLC timelocks use `2.0x` slow-block margins.
- **H-7 (Who anchors handoffs, who pays, mobile BTC headers):** Decoupled from `v1` custody; for Zenon light clients (`spec/04`), epoch handoff anchoring is a mandatory committee duty with Reserve fallback bounty, header sources (Neutrino/BIP-157, multi-source checkpoints, PoW header sync) and `minimumPostAnchorWork` are specified, and public wording is corrected (§8).
- **H-8 (Can a `SettlementContract` bug exceed `MaxRepresentationSupply`):** *Prevented structurally (`B3c`).* `SettlementContract` never holds more than the active cap tranche; excess pre-mint sits in timelocked `TreasuryTrancheEscrow`. Unit test required in Stage 0 (`G-11`).
- **M-9 (zBTC share of Zenon capacity & "millions of tx/s"):** Answered in **§3.2** and **§8**: `~8.8` transfers/s default (`~4.4` at pinned `2.1M` floor, `~4,386` at hard ceiling). "Millions of tx/s" is retired.
- **M-15 (Independent review of RFC):** Stage 1B explicitly blocks on an **independent third-party custody/HSM and bridge security review** outside the internal review loop; until completed, `v1` remains a pre-implementation RFC (`v3.0.0-rfc`), not a production approval.

<!-- BEGIN FILE: spec/01-bitcoin-taproot-vault-enforcement.md -->

# Part 1: Bitcoin Federated Custody Enforcement (`BTC-CUSTODY-F1`) & `v2` Research Annex

**Document Class:** Normative Bitcoin Custody Specification (`v1` / `v3.0.0-rfc`; supersedes `v0` `BTC-ENFORCEMENT-V1`)  
**Spec Identifier:** `BTC-CUSTODY-F1`  
**Precedence:** **Highest normative layer** ([`SPEC.md §2.1`](../SPEC.md#21-authority--conflict-precedence-m-13-fixed)) — honest federation signers MUST enforce Part 1 invariants even if Zenon contract state conflicts.  
**Target Chain:** Bitcoin Mainnet (`bip-0340` Schnorr, `bip-0341` Taproot, `bip-0342` Tapscript, `bip-0068`/`bip-0112` relative timelocks, SegWit v1 P2TR)  
**Consistency Checker:** [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](../scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py)

---

## 1. Custody Model & Explicit Scope

`v1` replaces `v0`'s never-deleted `N`-of-`N` `Q_graph` + BitVM2 hybrid with an **honest, auditable, capped `k`-of-`n` Tapscript HSM federation (`Tier F`)**. There is **no BitVM2**, **no fronting operators**, **no `N`-of-`N` standing key (`C-4, N-2`)**, and **no ZNN collateral in the Bitcoin safety path (`C-1`)**.

| Profile | Mechanism | Custody Trust Root | Status in `v1` |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier F (`BTC-CUSTODY-F1`, Normative `v1`)** | Taproot NUMS + `k`-of-`n` `OP_CHECKSIGADD` active HSM leaf (`7-of-10` pilot / `11-of-15` scaled) + `<52,560> OP_CSV` backup recovery leaf + dual-implementation signer policy (`B3a/B3b` + `settlementCodeHash` firewall) | `k`-of-`n` active federation safety; `n - k + 1` liveness; `k'`-of-`n'` recovery set after `52,560` blocks | **Normative `v1` target** |
| **Tier 1B (Optional Sovereign)** | Per-deposit self-custodial Taproot escrow (depositor co-signs key path + CLTV refund) | Depositor + counterparty per deposit | Optional separate non-fungible binding |
| **Tier 2 / Path A (`v2` Research Track)** | Deleted-key non-expiring BitVM / garbled circuits + ZK execution validity + Bitcoin-anchored fork choice | Gated on Research Gates **R-1..R-8** (Appendix A) | **Non-normative research annex** |

> **Explicit Custodial Disclosure (replacing `v0` C-07):** `Tier F` IS a federated custodial peg. Signer identities, jurisdictions, organizational separation, HSM hardware attestations, and independent signer-software builds MUST be published before Stage 1B activation.

---

## 2. Bitcoin Vault & Deposit Taproot Scripts

### 2.1 Canonical Vault Output (`VaultScript_F1`)

Every active federation vault UTXO is a SegWit v1 P2TR output (`OP_1 <32B x-only tweaked pubkey>`) with a provably unspendable **NUMS internal key**:
`H_NUMS_X = 0x50929b74c1a04954b78b4b6035e97a5e078a5a0f28ec96d547bfee9ace803ac0` (`lift_x(SHA256(uncompressed G))`)

The Taproot Merkle tree has **exact depth 1 (two Tapscript leaves)**:

1. **Leaf 1 — Active Federation (`k`-of-`n` `OP_CHECKSIGADD`):**
   ```text
   <pk_1> OP_CHECKSIG
   <pk_2> OP_CHECKSIGADD
   ...
   <pk_n> OP_CHECKSIGADD
   <OP_k> OP_NUMEQUAL
   ```
   - **Pilot (`Stage 1B`):** `7-of-10` (`342 B` script, `1,034 WU` = **`258.50 vB`/input**, `4.50×` key-path `57.5 vB`).
   - **Scaled:** `11-of-15` (`512 B` script, `1,465 WU` = **`366.25 vB`/input**, `6.37×` key-path `57.5 vB`).
   - *Why `OP_CHECKSIGADD` over FROST in `v1`:* Zero interactive DKG or MuSig2/FROST nonce-state footguns, natively supported on standard HSMs, every individual signer is auditable on-chain, and signer rotation is an explicit on-chain migration (since FROST resharing cannot cryptographically revoke old key shares anyway). The `4.5×–6.4×` input weight overhead is explicitly priced into peg-in fees and the Operations Reserve (§2.4).

2. **Leaf 2 — Custodial Backup Recovery (`<52,560> OP_CSV` + `k'`-of-`n'`):**
   ```text
   <0x50cd00> OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY OP_DROP
   <rpk_1> OP_CHECKSIG
   <rpk_2> OP_CHECKSIGADD
   ...
   <rpk_n'> OP_CHECKSIGADD
   <OP_k'> OP_NUMEQUAL
   ```
   - `T_RECOVERY_CSV = 52,560` Bitcoin blocks (~365 days nominal; strictly `<= 65,535` BIP-68 block-type limit; minimal little-endian script push `03 50cd00`).
   - Held by a distinct backup recovery set (`k'`-of-`n'`, e.g. `5-of-7`, separate HSMs and jurisdictions from the active quorum).
   - **Refresh is a safety duty, not hygiene:** Once a vault UTXO reaches `52,560` confirmations without being refreshed, Leaf 2 unlocks and the recovery set can race the active set. Every vault UTXO (including un-swept tweaked deposit outputs) MUST be refreshed on-chain before `T_REFRESH_TRIGGER = 26,280` blocks (~182.5 days, 50% of CSV). Any UTXO reaching `T_REFRESH_IMPAIRMENT = 39,420` blocks (~273.75 days, leaving `13,140` blocks ≈ 91.3 days margin) triggers an automatic **Impairment Alert & Mint Pause**.

### 2.2 Per-Recipient Deposit Output (`DepositScript_F1`, Closing `M-7`)

Each user peg-in targets a unique P2TR output using the tweaked internal key `P_dep = lift_x(H_NUMS_X) + H("zBTC/DepositTweak/v2", zenonRecipient(20B) || refundPk(32B)) * G` (unspendable NUMS tweak) with depth-1 Taproot tree:
- **Leaf 1:** Identical `k`-of-`n` `OP_CHECKSIGADD` active federation script (§2.1).
- **Leaf 2 (Unconditional User Refund):** `<288> OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY OP_DROP <refundPk> OP_CHECKSIG` (`~48h`, `>> K_pilot = 14`).

**Sweep Cutoff:** Signers MUST ONLY sweep deposits that have an active Zenon `ReserveMintCapacity` record AND whose confirmation height satisfies `h_tip < h_dep + 200` (leaving `>= 88` blocks safety margin before Leaf 2 matures). If a deposit cannot be swept (cap full, paused, or invalid), the user unilaterally reclaims via Leaf 2 after `288` blocks. Any swept deposit output not immediately consolidated MUST be tracked in the refresh calendar.

### 2.3 Federation Transaction Size Cap & Coinbase Verification

All federation-built transactions (`SweepTx`, `PayoutTx`, `RefreshTx`, `CancelTx`) MUST have **stripped (non-witness) serialized size `<= 6,144` bytes** (`MAX_FED_STRIPPED_TX_BYTES`), guaranteeing direct on-L1 SPV verification without streaming (`0x04` deleted from normative path).

### 2.4 Fee Floors, Fragmentation Defense & Operations Surplus Reserve

- **Minimum Deposit & Peg-Out Floor:** `100,000` sats (`0.001 BTC`). Arbitrary amounts above floor are supported (fixed `1.0 BTC` buckets deleted).
- **Consolidation Fee Floor (`PegInFee`):** Because `100,000`-sat script-path UTXOs become uneconomic dust above `386.8 sat/vB` (`7-of-10`) or `273.0 sat/vB` (`11-of-15`), every peg-in deducts `pegInFee >= ceil(input_vb * r_ref)` (`25,850` sats for `7-of-10`, `36,625` sats for `11-of-15` at `r_ref = 100 sat/vB`) into the vault surplus `S = V - Circ - P` to fund future refreshes and consolidations.
- **Peg-Out Fee:** Deducted directly from the user's gross burn (`netPayout = burnGross - userFeeShare`), with `sum(userFeeShare) >= maxFee(t)` across all outputs of a `BatchIntent` (RBF bumps above `sum(userFeeShare)` may draw only from surplus `S` subject to `B3a`).
- **Vault UTXO Cap & Seeded Surplus Reserve (`H-6`):** `MaxVaultUtxos = 64`. The Operations/Surplus Reserve `S` MUST be seeded prior to Stage 1B with at least `MaxVaultUtxos * ceil(input_vb) * 2,000 sat/vB` (covering April 2024's `>1,805 sat/vB` fee spike across all 64 vault UTXOs): `>= 0.33152 BTC` (`7-of-10`) or `>= 0.46976 BTC` (`11-of-15`) — **normative seed `>= 0.50 BTC`**.

---

## 3. Normative Dual-Implementation Signer Policy (`B3a`, `B3b`, `B4`, `H-3`)

Every federation signer MUST run its own full `bitcoind` node and its own pinned `go-zenon` full node. The federation MUST operate **at least two independently engineered signer implementations** (different teams/codebases, e.g. Rust + Go) so a single accounting bug cannot compromise quorum.

### 3.1 Mandatory Pre-Sign Verification Checklist (Evaluated on EVERY Spend)

Before producing a Schnorr signature on ANY payout, fee bump, sweep, refresh, or cancel transaction `new`, a signer MUST verify ALL of the following at a **single `K = 14`-deep Bitcoin snapshot** and a **single `D_znn = 60`-Momentum-deep Zenon snapshot** (`>= 2×` `protocol/chain_bridge.go:293`'s 30-Momentum rollback limit; zero U2 dependency):

1. **Cross-Signer Zenon Snapshot Agreement:** At least `k` independent signer nodes agree on the exact Zenon Momentum hash at the evaluation height `H_eval <= frontier - 60`.
2. **Pinned `settlementCodeHash` Upgrade Firewall (`H-3`):** The signer's local `go-zenon` node MUST match the signer operator's explicitly pinned `(activeSporkSetHash, goZenonReleaseDigest)` for `SettlementContract`. If an unapproved spork activates or mutates `SettlementContract` semantics, honest signers IMMEDIATELY halt signing until `>= k` signer operators independently audit and re-pin after the `>= 30-day` upgrade window.
3. **VM-Balance Supply Conservation (`B3b`):** Compute circulating supply strictly from **VM account balances** (never trusting `SettlementContract`'s internal counter alone):
   $$\text{Circ} = \text{TotalSupply} - \bigl(\text{Balance}(\text{SettlementContract}) + \text{Balance}(\text{TreasuryTrancheEscrow})\bigr)$$
   Assert **`Circ == SettlementContract.RepresentationOutstanding`**. On ANY mismatch, **HALT SIGNING IMMEDIATELY**, emit an emergency alert, and require manual forensic reconciliation. *(Honest disclosure: this stops unbacked `zBTC` from draining Bitcoin vaults via peg-outs, but cannot prevent an attacker from selling unbacked `zBTC` for BTC over PTLC/LN before the halt becomes public.)*
4. **Exact Conservation & Backing Inequality (`B3a`):** Let `V_conf` be the sum of all `K`-deep confirmed UTXOs controlled by the federation across ALL active vault scripts (including tweaked deposit addresses and legacy scripts during migration), and let `InFlight` be the set of all previously signed, unconfirmed federation transactions. Assert:
   $$V_{\text{conf}} - \sum_{t \in \text{InFlight} \cup \{\text{new}\}} \bigl(\text{nonVaultOut}(t) + \text{maxFee}(t)\bigr) \;\ge\; \text{Circ} + P - \sum_{t \in \text{InFlight} \cup \{\text{new}\}} \text{burnGross}(t)$$
   subject to:
   - `maxFee(t)` is the maximum fee across all signed RBF variants of `t`;
   - every `nonVaultOut` matches a `D_znn`-final `PegOutRecord` listed in a `D_znn`-final `BatchIntent`;
   - distinct in-flight transactions have **strictly disjoint inputs** (except RBF/cancel variants of the exact same `BatchIntent`);
   - **zero unconfirmed change chaining:** signers NEVER spend unconfirmed vault change (except a single federation CPFP child paying back to a valid vault script, also counted in `InFlight`).
5. **Zenon-Final `BatchIntent` First (`B4`):** For every payout transaction, a matching `BatchIntent(intentId, inputs[], outputs[], feeCapSats)` MUST be `D_znn`-final on Zenon BEFORE any signer signs. All RBF fee bumps MUST reuse the identical `inputs[]` set.
6. **24-Hour Velocity Limit:** Cumulative `nonVaultOut` signed over the trailing 24 hours MUST NOT exceed the policy velocity cap (pilot default: `2.5 BTC / 24h`, adjustable via Governance + `>= k` signers).

### 3.2 Signer-Set Rotation & On-Chain Migration

Rotating signer keys (`Set A → Set B`) is ALWAYS an **explicit on-chain migration**:
1. Governance + `>= k` signers register `Set B`'s `ChainBinding` (`>= 14d` timelock).
2. New deposits target `Set B`; existing `Set A` vaults are swept into `Set B` vault outputs by `Set A` signers (preserving `B3a` across the union `V_conf(Set A) + V_conf(Set B)`).
3. Once `V_conf(Set A) == 0` for `>= K = 14` blocks, `Set A` is retired.

---

## 4. Machine-Readable Proof-of-Reserves

Signers publish a signed, reproducible Proof-of-Reserves bundle every `6` hours (and within `2` hours of any pause/impairment):
- Exact list of `K`-deep vault UTXOs (outpoint, script descriptor, value, confirmation height, age vs `T_REFRESH_TRIGGER`);
- All signed `InFlight` `BatchIntent`s and `maxFee(t)` bounds;
- Zenon snapshot `(H_eval, momentumHash)`, VM `Circ`, `RepresentationOutstanding`, `PendingForeignRelease`, `Balance(SettlementContract)`, `Balance(TreasuryTrancheEscrow)`, and surplus `S = V_conf - Circ - P`.

---

## 5. Impairment, Permanent Failure & Wind-Down Plan (With Explicit Loss Model)

1. **Impairment Triggers:** `B3b` mismatch (`Circ != RepresentationOutstanding`), `B3a` violation, unexpected vault spend not matching a signed `BatchIntent`, any vault UTXO age `>= 39,420` blocks unrefreshed, Bitcoin reorg `> K = 14` orphaning an admitted lock/release, Operations Reserve `S` falling below `50%` of the stress refresh floor, or `>= n - k + 1` active signers offline for `> 72` hours.
2. **Pause Scope (`H-3`):** Pause freezes new mints (`ReserveMintCapacity`, `SubmitSweepLockProof`) and new deposit sweeps ONLY. **`RequestPegOut`, `SubmitHeaderBatch`, `SubmitReleaseProof`, `SubmitConflictRefundProof`, and honest signer payouts STAY OPEN.**
3. **Incident Snapshot:** Publish `(H_eval, momentumHash, V_conf, Circ, P, InFlight[], ActiveReservations[], Surplus S)` within `2` hours.
4. **Orderly Wind-Down (Active Quorum Alive):** Federation ceases sweeps, lets pending deposits refund via Leaf 2 (`288` blks), fulfills all `RequestPegOut` requests FIFO up to `100%` of `Circ + P`, and cancels stuck `BatchIntent`s via conflict-proof re-spends (`B4`).
5. **Recovery-Leaf Wind-Down (`>= n - k + 1` Active Signers Permanently Lost):**
   - Wait until vault UTXOs reach `52,560` blocks (`<= 365` days worst-case wait from last refresh).
   - Backup recovery set (`k'`-of-`n'`) sweeps all remaining vault BTC into an audited pro-rata Wind-Down distribution contract/payout list covering all verified `zBTC` holders (`Circ`) plus unpaid `PendingForeignRelease` claims (`P`) at their **gross** burn amount.
6. **Explicit Loss Model:**
   - *Active-quorum loss / liveness failure:* **0% principal loss** (minus Bitcoin sweep/payout fees); time-value lockup of up to `52,560` blocks (~365 days).
   - *Partial theft / unbacked Zenon mint exploit sold externally:* Any shortfall `Δ = (Circ + P) - V_remaining` is disclosed transparently in the PoR snapshot and distributed strictly **pro-rata** (`payout_i = claim_i * V_remaining / (Circ + P)`); zero silent socialization.
   - *Total `k`-of-`n` active collusion or `k'`-of-`n'` recovery collusion after maturity:* **Up to 100% loss of vault BTC.** This risk is irreducible in `Tier F` and is bounded solely by signer independence, HSM controls, velocity limits, and the `5.0 BTC` pilot cap.

---

## Appendix A: Non-Normative `v2` Research Annex (Path A: Trust-Minimized BitVM)

> **Status: NON-NORMATIVE RESEARCH TRACK.** Nothing in `v1` (`Tier F`) relies on this annex, and no public material may claim trust minimization until ALL eight Research Gates (**R-1..R-8**) below are empirically closed and audited.

### A.1 Why `v0`'s BitVM2 Hybrid Could Not Be Patched Into `v1`

Without Bitcoin covenants, a bridge can have at most two of: (i) deleted setup keys, (ii) a rotating PoS committee root pinned inside pre-signed graphs, and (iii) no standing custodial key. Pinning Zenon's 30-day committee root forced `58d` graph expiry → `30d` re-graphing → never-deleted `N`-of-`N` `Q_graph` (`C-4`) and `N`-of-`N` `CommitteeIdentityKey` (`N-2`). Independently, trusting committee-signed state tied safety to ZNN's thin market cap (`C-1, C-2, H-1..H-3`), and unchunked/Groth16 BitVM2 script sizes blew up `F_assert` and watcher economics (`C-3, H-4, M-6`).

### A.2 Mandatory Research Gates for `v2` (`R-1` through `R-8`)

| Gate | Requirement to Enter `v2` Spec |
|---|---|
| **R-1 (ZK State Validity)** | Either a full **ZK light client of Zenon execution** covering every block touching `zBTC` balances + all mint/burn/refund handlers, OR moving `zBTC` into a **ZK-proven execution domain** (explicitly accepting the trade-off of losing native feeless block-lattice transfers). Pin `vk` per vault (providing `H-3` upgrade isolation) and define a migration path for bug fixes. |
| **R-2 (Bitcoin-Anchored Full-Node Fork Choice)** | Adopt "earliest Bitcoin-anchored certified branch wins" in **Zenon full-node consensus** (not light clients alone), and make timely Bitcoin anchoring of every epoch handoff a mandatory committee duty backed by a Reserve bounty (`H-7` becomes Critical once graphs stop expiring). |
| **R-3 (In-Circuit Bitcoin Header Chain + Watchtower Challenge)** | Prove `FrontingTx` Bitcoin SPV + header chain inside the BitVM circuit paired with a watchtower chain-work challenge (preventing private-fork proofs). |
| **R-4 (Measured Signet Script Weights)** | Empirical Signet comparison of modern **BitVM2** vs **garbled circuits (BitVM3 / DV-SNARK)**. Measure real assert and disprove sizes; prove every disprove leaf is `< 400 kWU` standard OR specify a non-standard miner submission path and its censorship model (`C-3, M-6`). *(Note: Leaf-3B cert-DA SHA-256 disappears once validity proofs replace ZNN slashing.)* |
| **R-5 (Non-Front-Runnable Watcher Incentives)** | Solve `H-4` via a front-run-resistant watcher reward (or protocol-paid bonded watchtower set) and re-derive `F_assert`, operator bonds, and `D_bucket` from **R-4** measurements. |
| **R-6 (Deleted-Key Non-Expiring Graphs & Operator-Loss Policy)** | Per-deposit deleted setup keys (NUMS key path, zero 30d re-graphing) with an explicit policy decision on total operator-set loss: either accept permanent unrecoverability (pure `C-07`) OR include a long-timelock recovery leaf and disclose it honestly (`C-4`). Require certificate availability *before* kickoff (`H-2` fix) if any committee cert remains. |
| **R-7 (Parallel Exit Throughput)** | Support multiple concurrent kickoffs per operator round and publish worst-case time-to-exit math for 100% of supply (`H-5`). |
| **R-8 (`v1` → `v2` Migration Path)** | Define opt-in migration where `Tier F` federation signers sweep `v1` vault BTC directly into `v2` vaults (or launch `v2` under a distinct `AssetID`). |

# Part 2: Direct-on-L1 Trimmed Bitcoin SPV Verifier (`vm/embedded/btcspv`)

**Document Class:** Normative Bitcoin SPV Verification Specification (`v1` / `v3.0.0-rfc`; supersedes `v0` `d_btc_asset` optimistic domain)  
**Shared Implementation Mandate:** Deterministic, pure-Go, **panic-recovered (`B1`)** package `vm/embedded/btcspv/` executed directly inside `SettlementContract` on Zenon L1 (no separate optimistic execution domain, no executors, no 48h challenge window).  
**Consistency Checker:** [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](../scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py)

---

## 1. Direct-on-L1 Architecture & `ChainBinding` (`D4` Locked)

In `v1`, Bitcoin header tracking and transaction inclusion verification run **directly on Zenon L1** as ABI methods on `SettlementContract`, paired with `>= k` federation co-signatures on sweep locks and batch intents. This eliminates `v0`'s optimistic `BatchCommitmentV3`, `StepTraceLeaf`, `zenon-executor`, Multi-Tx Witness Sessions, 48h (+12h) finalization lag, and findings **C-2 (case 1), M-5 (deposit spam), N-3, and N-4**.

```text
ChainBinding {
    foreignChainId        : ChainId   // u16(0x0001) || bytes30(SHA3-256("BTC_MAINNET_V1" || btcGenesisHashBE)[0:30])
    chainVerifierId       : bytes32   // SHA3-256("BTC_SPV_VERIFIER_V3.0" || reproducibleBuildDigest)  [L-4 fixed]
    genesisAnchor         : Bytes     // BitcoinAnchor { blockHashBE, height, header(80B), cumWork, retargetStartHash, retargetStartTime, retargetHeight, mtpWindow[11] }
    custodySpecHash       : bytes32   // SHA3-256(activated BTC-CUSTODY-F1 bytes); MUST be non-zero
    activeFederationSet   : Bytes     // { k(u8), n(u8), sortedPubkeys[n](32B each), recoveryCsvBlocks(u32=52560), recoveryScriptHash(32B) }
    finalityParams        : Bytes     // BitcoinFinalityParams below
}
```

### 1.1 `BitcoinFinalityParams`

```text
BitcoinFinalityParams :=
    confirmationDepthK         : u32   // Pilot: 14. Satisfies K >= max(12, ceil(2 * Cap_BTC / Subsidy(h))) across pre-2028 (12), post-2028 (12), and post-2032 (13) at 5.0 BTC cap!
    minimumPostAnchorWork      : u256  // Normative floor: K_pilot * blockWork(genesisAnchor.nBits) (must accumulate >= 14 blocks at anchor difficulty before any event proof is admitted)
    retainedReorgDepth         : u32   // 144 blocks (stale HeaderNode pruning ONLY; ActiveChainByHeight NEVER pruned)
    maximumHeaderBatch         : u32   // 2 headers per SubmitHeaderBatch call
    maximumMerkleBranchDepth   : u32   // 16 levels (65,536 txs/block)
    maximumFedStrippedTxBytes  : u32   // 6,144 B (stripped non-witness bytes for federation-built Sweep/Payout/Conflict txs; streaming 0x04 deleted!)
    depositRefundCsvBlocks     : u32   // 288 blocks (~48h)
    depositSweepCutoffBlocks   : u32   // 200 blocks (leaves >= 88 blocks safety buffer >> K=14)
    futureTimeGuardSecs        : u32   // 7,200 s
    equalWorkTieBreak          : u8    // 0 = LOWEST_BLOCK_HASH_BE (documented difference from Bitcoin Core first-seen; bounded by K=14)
```

> **Stage 0 Testnet Caveat:** On Bitcoin Signet (where block validity sits in the coinbase signature) and testnet4 (minimum-difficulty rules), header-only SPV does not resist an adversary. Stage 0 Signet SPV tests are explicitly labeled **conformance-only**; full PoW security applies only on Bitcoin Mainnet.

---

## 2. Direct-on-L1 SPV ABI Methods & Plasma Floor (`B1`, `B2`)

All `v0` BitVM-only input tags (`0x04` streaming, `0x08`–`0x0D`, `0x0F`, `0x10`) and `0x03` (`PEGOUT_CREATED` is now direct `SettlementContract` state) are **deleted**. Every SPV method executes directly on L1 with strict CPU, storage-access, and ABI bounds, and **MUST wrap execution in `recover()` converting any panic into a deterministic method error** so a crafted send can NEVER stall `SettlementContract`'s FIFO receive queue (`dev:verifier/account_block.go:508`, **B1**).

| ABI Method | Send Plasma Tier (`B2`) | Max Payload | Max ABI | Base Plasma (`QSR`) | Max Storage Ops | Purpose |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `SubmitHeaderBatch(headers)` | `52,500` (Simple) | `197 B` | `324 B` | `74,260` (`36 QSR`) | `<= 8` | Validate `1..2` mainnet headers, 2016-block retarget, MTP, `ActiveChainByHeight`. |
| `StepReorg()` | `52,500` (Simple) | `0 B` | `4 B` | `52,500` (`25 QSR`) | `<= 6` | Walk 1 incremental reorg step; sets `Halted = 1` (mints paused ONLY) if an admitted event block is orphaned or `ReorgSteps > 144`. |
| `PruneStaleHeaders(hashes)` | `52,500` (Simple) | `65 B` | `196 B` | `65,556` (`32 QSR`) | `<= 4` | Delete `1..2` stale `HeaderNode`s (`height < BestTip - 144 && height % 2016 != 0 && ReorgActive == 0`). |
| `ReserveMintCapacity(...)` | `52,500` (Simple) | `64 B` | `164 B` | `63,380` (`31 QSR`) | `<= 4` | Reserve cap space before sweep (`M-7`); expires after `288` BTC blocks. |
| `PostBatchIntent(...)` | `52,500` (Simple) | `2,604 B` | `2,724 B` | `237,460` (`114 QSR`) | `<= 20` | Commit federation payout `inputs[]`, `outputs[]`, `feeCapSats`, `>= k` sigs before signing (`B4`). |
| `SubmitSweepLockProof(...)` | `73,500` (Heavy SPV) | `8,532 B` | `8,644 B` | `661,020` (`315 QSR`) | `<= 24` | Verify `K`-deep `SweepTx` (`<= 6 KiB` stripped) + coinbase midstate + `>= k` federation attestation → atomic mint. |
| `SubmitReleaseProof(...)` | `73,500` (Heavy SPV) | `7,344 B` | `7,460 B` | `580,508` (`277 QSR`) | `<= 20` | Verify `K`-deep `PayoutTx` matching `BatchIntent` → mark `PegOutRecord`s `RELEASED` (NO upper deadline!). |
| `SubmitConflictRefundProof(...)` | `73,500` (Heavy SPV) | `7,376 B` | `7,492 B` | `582,684` (`278 QSR`) | `<= 10` | Verify `K`-deep tx spending a `BatchIntent` input WITHOUT paying `outboxId` → atomic refund (`B4`). |

> **Mandatory B2 Plasma Floor:** Because `go-zenon` embedded receives cost `0` Plasma (`dev:vm/plasma.go:147`) and `SetPlasmaVariables` can currently lower `MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum` to `210,000` (`dev:vm/embedded/definition/plasma.go:66`), which blocks any call larger than `2,011 B` (`Heavy`) / `2,320 B` (`Simple`) in `pillar/content_selector.go:328`, the `v1` zBTC spork MUST enforce **`DynamicPlasmaSpork` active FIRST** and pin **`MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum >= 2,100,000`** (`>= 3×` the largest `661,020`-Plasma SPV call!). Direct L1 calls pay Plasma only (no `SubmitInput` ZNN deposit or refund machinery).

---

## 3. Deterministic Verification Rules (`vm/embedded/btcspv`)

### 3.1 Header Validation, Reorgs & `Halted` Semantics

- **`SubmitHeaderBatch`:** Exact Bitcoin mainnet `SetCompact`, 2016-block `[302400, 4838400]`s retarget, embedded `mtpWindow[11]`, `futureTimeGuardSecs = 7,200`, `LOWEST_BLOCK_HASH_BE` equal-work tie-break *(note: differs from Bitcoin Core's first-seen rule; any single-block tie resolves well within `K = 14`)*. Writes **`ActiveChainByHeight[height] = blockHashBE(32B) || merkleRootLE(32B) || blockTime(u32BE, 4B)` (68 B)** — **NEVER PRUNED**.
- **`ReorgActive` Guard:** Every event proof (`SubmitSweepLockProof`, `SubmitReleaseProof`, `SubmitConflictRefundProof`) MUST reject while `ChainMeta.ReorgActive == 1` OR `ChainMeta.PostAnchorWork < minimumPostAnchorWork`.
- **`Halted` Scope:** Deep reorg (`> 144` or orphaning an admitted block) sets `ChainMeta.Halted = 1`, which **pauses new mints ONLY** (`ReserveMintCapacity`, `SubmitSweepLockProof`). It **NEVER blocks `RequestPegOut`, `PostBatchIntent`, `SubmitReleaseProof`, or `SubmitConflictRefundProof`**.

### 3.2 Coinbase Midstate Proof (CVE-2017-12842 Without Streaming `0x04`)

Every transaction proof MUST verify:
1. `ActiveChainByHeight[blockHeight]` exists and `BestTipHeight >= blockHeight + K - 1`.
2. `len(strippedTx) <= 6,144` and `len(strippedTx) != 64` (CVE-2017-12842) and `txIndex != 0`.
3. Zero SegWit marker (`0x00 0x01`) in stripped bytes; `doubleSHA256(strippedTx)` matches `txBranch` against `merkleRootLE` with `len(txBranch) == len(coinbaseBranch)` and no duplicate-node CVE-2012-2459 padding.
4. **Coinbase Midstate Proof (`<= 616 B`):** Because mainnet coinbase transactions can pay hundreds of pool miners and exceed several KB, the verifier does NOT require raw coinbase bytes or `0x04` streaming. Instead, the caller supplies `(sha256Midstate(32B), finalChunkTail(<=64B), totalCoinbaseBytes(u32), coinbaseBranch)`: the verifier asserts `totalCoinbaseBytes != 64` (blocking 64-byte leaf forgery), completes the final SHA-256 compression + second SHA-256 round to recover `coinbaseTxid`, and verifies `coinbaseBranch` at index `0` with `len(coinbaseBranch) == len(txBranch)`.

### 3.3 Event Proof Rules

1. **`SubmitSweepLockProof`:**
   - Requires `Halted == 0`, `ReorgActive == 0`, and `K`-deep inclusion of `strippedSweepTx`.
   - Parses all outputs paying recognized `BTC-CUSTODY-F1` vault scripts; computes `totalVaultOutSats`.
   - Verifies `>= k` distinct valid BIP-340 Schnorr signatures from `activeFederationSet` (individual keys, NEVER aggregated `N`-of-`N` — closing **N-2**) over `SHA3-256("ZBTC_SWEEP_MINT_V1" || chainBindingHash || sweepTxid || canonical(mintAllocations[]))`.
   - Each allocation `(depositOutpoint, zenonRecipient, netMintSats, pegInFeeSats)` MUST satisfy: (i) `DepositOutpointUsed[depositOutpoint]` absent (permanent replay key), (ii) `pegInFeeSats >= ceil(input_vb * r_ref)`, (iii) `netMintSats + pegInFeeSats >= 100,000`, and (iv) `sum(netMintSats + pegInFeeSats) <= totalVaultOutSats` (bounding total mints on-chain by actual vault outputs!).
   - *Explicit Auditability Disclosure:* Because stripped Bitcoin transactions omit input amounts, on-chain SPV enforces the total vault-output upper bound and deposit-outpoint replay uniqueness, while per-recipient attribution is attested by `>= k` signers and independently auditable off-chain from Bitcoin's Taproot sighash input amounts.
2. **`SubmitReleaseProof` (No Upper Deadline!):**
   - Verifies `K`-deep inclusion of `strippedPayoutTx` spending `BatchIntent.inputs[]` and creating every `(spk, netSats)` output in `BatchIntent.outputs[]`.
   - **No upper height deadline:** A delayed or fee-starved payout can ALWAYS be proven once confirmed, marking each `PegOutRecord` `RELEASED` and decrementing `PendingForeignRelease`.
3. **`SubmitConflictRefundProof` (`B4` — Conflict-Only Refunds):**
   - Verifies `K`-deep inclusion of `strippedConflictTx` spending **at least one input** in `BatchIntent.inputs[]`, such that `strippedConflictTx` does **NOT** contain the `(spk, netSats)` output for `outboxId` (and `outboxId` is still `INTENT`).
   - Atomically marks `PegOutRecord[outboxId]` `REFUNDED`, decrements `PendingForeignRelease`, increments `RepresentationOutstanding`, and returns `grossAmountSats` `zBTC` to `refundRecipient`. Because Bitcoin inputs cannot be double-spent, a refunded peg-out can NEVER later confirm on Bitcoin.

---

## 4. Verifier Storage Layout (`SettlementContract` SPV Sub-Prefix)

| Prefix | Key | Value | Pruning Policy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x20` | singleton | `ChainMeta` (`BestTipHash`, `BestTipHeight`, `BestTipWork`, `PostAnchorWork`, `ReorgActive`, `Halted`) | Never pruned |
| `0x21` | `blockHashBE(32B)` | `HeaderNode` (`160 B`, incl. `mtpWindow[11]`) | Pruned via `PruneStaleHeaders` when `< BestTip - 144 && height % 2016 != 0 && ReorgActive == 0` |
| `0x22` | `u64BE(height)` | `ActiveChainByHeight` (`68 B`: `blockHashBE \|\| merkleRootLE \|\| blockTime`) | **NEVER PRUNED** |
| `0x23` | `u64BE(height)` | `AdmittedEventBlocks` (`admittedBlockHashBE`) | Never pruned |
| `0x24` | `depositOutpoint(36B)` | `u8(1)` (`DepositOutpointUsed`) | Never pruned |
| `0x25` | `sweepTxid(32B)` | `u8(1)` (`SweepProcessed`) | Never pruned |
| `0x26` | `chainBindingHash(32B)` | `ChainBinding` (`RecognizedBindings`, Governance + `>= k` fed) | Never pruned |

---

## 5. Mandatory SPV Conformance Test Vectors

1. All 24 Bitcoin header, difficulty retarget (`[302400, 4838400]`s), MTP, `futureTimeGuardSecs`, `LOWEST_BLOCK_HASH_BE` tie-break, `CVE-2012-2459`, and `CVE-2017-12842` (`len == 64` rejection) vectors.
2. **Coinbase Midstate Proof:** Valid multi-KB coinbase midstate acceptance; `totalCoinbaseBytes == 64` rejection; mismatched `len(coinbaseBranch) != len(txBranch)` rejection.
3. **`ReorgActive` & `Halted` Isolation:** Event proofs rejected while `ReorgActive == 1`; `Halted = 1` blocks `ReserveMintCapacity` / `SubmitSweepLockProof` while keeping `RequestPegOut`, `PostBatchIntent`, `SubmitReleaseProof`, and `SubmitConflictRefundProof` open.
4. **Sweep Bound & Replay:** `SubmitSweepLockProof` rejects when `sum(mints + fees) > totalVaultOutSats`, when `< k` distinct valid signer signatures are supplied, or on duplicate `depositOutpoint`.
5. **Conflict Refund vs Release (`B4`):** `SubmitConflictRefundProof` succeeds ONLY when a `K`-deep tx spends a `BatchIntent` input without paying `outboxId`; rejects timeout-only claims and rejects after `RELEASED`.
6. **Panic-Free Fuzz Gate (`B1`):** Randomized/malformed ABI payloads across all 8 methods MUST return deterministic method errors and NEVER panic or stall the FIFO receive queue.

<!-- BEGIN FILE: spec/03-settlement-minted-zbtc-and-feeless-rails.md -->

# Part 3: Lightweight Settlement Contract, Tranche-Isolated `zBTC`, Dynamic Plasma & Peg-Free Rails

**Document Class:** Normative L1 Settlement, Tokenomics & Peg-Free Application Specification (`v1` / `v3.0.0-rfc`)  
**Target Baseline:** `go-zenon` first release tag containing `0aa299e` (`DynamicPlasmaSpork` enforced; `#239` closed)  
**Contracts:** `SettlementContract` & `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` ([`spec/05 §4`](./05-go-zenon-upgrade-plan.md))  
**Consistency Checker:** [`scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py`](../scripts/verify_spec_bounds.py)

---

## 1. Tranche-Isolated Treasury Pre-Mint Issuance (`H-8`, `B3c`, `A-MINT-1`)

In `go-zenon`, `TokenContract` does not intercept standard transfers and `MaxSupply` cannot be raised after issuance (`dev:vm/embedded/implementation/token.go:330`). Putting all `21,000,000 zBTC` inside `SettlementContract` (as `v0` did) meant a single `SettlementContract` dispatch bug could mint up to `21M` unbacked `zBTC` (**H-8**).

**`v1` isolates blast radius with a separate `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` embedded contract (`B3c`):**

1. **Step 1 — `TreasuryTrancheEscrow.InitiateMintedToken("ZenonBitcoin", "zBTC", domain, 8, 21_000_000*10^8)`** (Governance, attaches `1 ZNN`):
   - Emits descendant `ContractSend` calling `TokenContract.IssueMinted(...)` (`sendBlock.Address == types.TreasuryTrancheEscrow`, exempts `checkToken` regexes `dev:vm/embedded/implementation/token.go:40,43`, sets `TotalSupply = MaxSupply = 21M*10^8`, `IsMintable = false`, `IsBurnable = false`, `Owner = types.TreasuryTrancheEscrow`).
   - `TokenContract` sends all `21,000,000 * 10^8 zBTC` via `Data = ABITrancheEscrow.PackMethod("ReceiveInitialTreasury")` (`dev:vm/vm.go:204-226`). `ReceiveInitialTreasury()` is single-use (`TreasuryInitialized == 0`).
   - **Sealing `TokenContract`:** `TokenContract.UpdateToken` and `TokenContract.Burn` reject whenever `tokenInfo.Owner == types.TreasuryTrancheEscrow`.
2. **Step 2 — Timelocked Cap Tranche Release (`ReleaseCapTranche`):**
   - `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` releases ONLY `<= ActiveCap` (Stage 1B: **`5.0 BTC` = `500,000,000` base units**) to `SettlementContract.ReceiveTranche()`.
   - Any subsequent cap increase requires a **`GovernanceContract` vote + `>= k` federation co-signature + `>= 14-day` timelock** before releasing the incremental tranche delta.
   - `SettlementContract` can return excess treasury to `TreasuryTrancheEscrow` on cap reductions (`GuardianLowerSupplyCap`).
3. **Exact VM Conservation Invariant (`B3b`):**
   $$\text{Circ} = 21{,}000{,}000 \times 10^8 - \bigl(\text{Balance}(\text{SettlementContract}) + \text{Balance}(\text{TreasuryTrancheEscrow})\bigr)$$
   - `SettlementContract.Balance(zBTC)` NEVER exceeds `ActiveCap` (`5.0 BTC` at Stage 1B). Even a catastrophic bug inside `SettlementContract` is structurally bounded by its held tranche — never `21M BTC`!
   - Federation signers independently check `Circ == RepresentationOutstanding` from VM balances on every spend (`spec/01 §3.1`).

---

## 2. Minimal `SettlementContract` Storage & State Transitions

All `v0` BitVM2 / optimistic-rollup state (`BatchCommitmentV3`, `StepTraceLeaf`, `DomainInputBySeq`, `ChallengeSession`, `ExecutorRegistration`, `OperatorRegistry`, `OperatorLaneState`, `VaultUtxoSet` quarantine/`ORPHANED`, `DeferredLockQueue`, fronting slots, `SlotBondZnn`) is **removed**.

### 2.1 Storage Prefixes (`SettlementContract`)

| Prefix | Entity | Key | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x01` | `BridgeConfig` | singleton | `activeCapSats(u64)`, `activeBindingHash(32B)`, `status(0=ACTIVE\|1=PAUSED)`, `minDepositSats(u64=100_000)`, `minPegInFeeSats(u64)`, `governanceContract`, `guardianMultisig` |
| `0x02` | `CustodyAccounting` | singleton | `representationOutstanding(u64)`, `pendingForeignRelease(u64)`, `activeReservedMint(u64)`, `cumulativeMinted(u64)`, `cumulativeBurned(u64)`, `cumulativeReleased(u64)`, `cumulativeRefunded(u64)` |
| `0x03` | `MintReservation` | `reservationId(32B)` | `zenonRecipient(20B)`, `expectedAmountSats(u64)`, `expiryBtcHeight(u64)` (`BestTip + 288`), `consumed(u8)` (`M-7`) |
| `0x04` | `PegOutNonce` | singleton | `u64` monotonic counter |
| `0x05` | `PegOutRecord` | `outboxId(32B)` | `outboxId = SHA3-256("ZNN_L1_PEGOUT_V2" \|\| chainBindingHash \|\| pegOutSeq \|\| sendBlockHash)`, `recipientScriptPubKey`, `refundRecipient(20B)`, `grossAmountSats(u64)`, `maxUserFeeSats(u64)`, `intentId(32B, 0 if unassigned)`, one-way `state(0=PENDING\|1=INTENT\|2=RELEASED\|3=REFUNDED)` |
| `0x06` | `BatchIntent` | `intentId(32B)` | `inputs[](36B each)`, `outputs[](outboxId, spk, netSats)`, `feeCapSats(u64)`, `postedHeight(u64)`, `status(0=OPEN\|1=CONFIRMED\|2=CONFLICTED)` (`B4`) |
| `0x20`–`0x26` | `btcspv` Sub-Store | *(see Part 2 §4)* | `ChainMeta`, `HeaderNode`, `ActiveChainByHeight`, `AdmittedEventBlocks`, `DepositOutpointUsed`, `SweepProcessed`, `RecognizedBindings` |

### 2.2 Core Settlement Methods (All Wrapped in `recover()` — `B1`)

- **`ReserveMintCapacity(reservationId, expectedAmountSats, zenonRecipient)` (`M-7`):** Requires `status == ACTIVE && ChainMeta.Halted == 0` and `representationOutstanding + pendingForeignRelease + activeReservedMint + expectedAmountSats <= activeCapSats`. Stores `MintReservation` expiring at `BestTipHeight + 288`. Expired reservations are permissionlessly pruned by `ExpireMintReservation`.
- **`SubmitSweepLockProof(...)`:** Verifies `K`-deep sweep SPV + `>= k` federation attestation (`spec/02 §3.3 #1`), consumes matching `MintReservation` (or checks cap directly), increments `representationOutstanding` and `cumulativeMinted`, and sends `netMintSats` `zBTC` from `SettlementContract`'s tranche to each `zenonRecipient`.
- **`RequestPegOut(recipientScriptPubKey, maxUserFeeSats)`** *(ALWAYS open, even when `PAUSED` or `Halted == 1`)*: User attaches `grossAmountSats >= 100,000` `zBTC` (returned to `SettlementContract`'s tranche). Decrements `representationOutstanding`, increments `pendingForeignRelease` and `cumulativeBurned`, writes `PegOutRecord{state = PENDING}`.
- **`PostBatchIntent(intentId, inputs[], outputs[], feeCapSats, fedSigs[>=k])` (`B4`):** Verifies `>= k` federation signatures, checks each `outboxId` is `PENDING` with `netSats >= grossAmountSats - maxUserFeeSats` and `sum(gross - net) >= feeCapSats` (or surplus-funded flag), checks `inputs[]` disjoint from other `OPEN` intents, transitions each `PegOutRecord` `PENDING -> INTENT`.
- **`SubmitReleaseProof(...)`:** Verifies `K`-deep payout tx matching `BatchIntent` (`spec/02 §3.3 #2`), transitions `BatchIntent -> CONFIRMED`, marks all `outputs[]` `PegOutRecord -> RELEASED`, decrements `pendingForeignRelease`, increments `cumulativeReleased`. *(No upper height deadline.)*
- **`SubmitConflictRefundProof(intentId, outboxId, ...)` (`B4`):** Verifies `K`-deep conflict tx spending any `BatchIntent.inputs[]` without paying `outboxId` (`spec/02 §3.3 #3`), transitions `PegOutRecord -> REFUNDED`, decrements `pendingForeignRelease`, increments `representationOutstanding` and `cumulativeRefunded`, and atomically sends `grossAmountSats` `zBTC` back to `refundRecipient`. *(Resolves `M-8` by construction; no refund escrow needed.)*

---

## 3. Dynamic Plasma Capacity Budget & Momentum Timing (`B2`, `M-9`, `M-10`)

- **Observed Momentum Interval (`M-10`):** Mainnet Momentums average **`~11.4s`** (`11.35–11.46s`, documented in `origin/dev:vm/embedded/definition/spork.go`), NOT `10s`. All deadlines in this spec are expressed in a single canonical unit (Bitcoin blocks for Bitcoin scripts, Zenon Momentums for signer depth `D_znn = 60`, or explicit seconds at `11.4s`/Momentum).
- **Dynamic Plasma Bounds (`B2`, `M-9`):**
  - `MaxAccountBlocksInMomentum = 100` is retired under `DynamicPlasmaSpork`. Capacity is governed by `MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum` (`dev:vm/embedded/definition/plasma.go:57-97`).
  - **Pinned Spork Floor (`B2`):** `MintedZbtcSpork` enforces **`MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum >= 2,100,000`** (`SetPlasmaVariables` MUST reject any lower value) and bounds `MaxPriceChangePercent <= 25%` per Momentum. This guarantees the largest `v1` SPV call (`SubmitSweepLockProof`, `8,644 B` ABI, `661,020` Plasma) ALWAYS fits (`>= 3` max-SPV calls/Momentum at floor, `6` at default `4,200,000`).
  - **Contract-Block Budget:** Embedded receives cost `0` Plasma (`dev:vm/plasma.go:147`) and share the per-Momentum contract-block cap `MaxBasePlasmaInMomentum / 52,500` (`40` at pinned floor, `80` at default `4.2M`, `dev:dp/dp.go:260`). Heavy SPV methods therefore pay `EMBEDDED_HEAVY_SPV_TIER = 73,500` + `68/byte` on send and enforce hard storage-op caps (`<= 24` ops, `spec/02 §2`).
  - **Honest User Transfer Throughput (`11.4s`/Momentum):** `~4.4` full send+receive `zBTC` transfers/s at the `2.1M` floor, `~8.8` transfers/s at the `4.2M` default, and `~4,386` transfers/s at the `2.1B` hard protocol ceiling.

---

## 4. Governance & Guardian Narrowing Controls (`H-3`)

- **`MultisigContract` (Guardian `5-of-9` Ed25519):** Narrowing actions ONLY — `GuardianPause` (sets `status = PAUSED`, halting mints/sweeps only; NEVER blocks `RequestPegOut` or payouts) and `GuardianLowerSupplyCap`.
- **`GovernanceContract` (`U5`, Stage 1B Hard Gate):** Controls `ReleaseCapTranche` (`>= 14d` timelock + `>= k` federation), `AddBinding` (`>= 14d` + `>= k` federation), `ResumeMinting` (`>= 48h` + `>= k` federation), and protocol sporks (`>= 30d` timelock for custody-relevant code).

---

## 5. Peg-Free Atomic Swaps & Lightning Submarine-Swap Gateway (`M-4` Hardened)

> **Scope Honesty:** Swaps execute atomically with zero intermediary custody risk during the swap, **but the `zBTC` asset received remains backed by the `Tier F` federation vaults.**

### 5.1 PTLC Taproot MuSig2 Adaptor Atomic Swap (BIP-327 Tweaked)

**Protocol (Alice sells BTC, Bob sells `zBTC`; Bob holds secret $t$):**
1. **Setup:** Bob samples $t \in \mathbb{Z}_n^*$, sends compressed 33-byte point $T = \text{compress}(t \cdot G)$ to Alice.
2. **Bitcoin Funding (BIP-327 Tweaked Taproot, `>= 72`-Block CSV):** Compute $P_{\text{swap}} = \text{MuSig2\_KeyAgg}(pk_A, pk_B)$, Tapscript refund leaf $L_{\text{ref}} = \text{<72> OP\_CSV OP\_DROP <pk\_A> OP\_CHECKSIG}$ (upgraded from `v0`'s unsafe `12` blocks!), tweak $t_{\text{tap}} = H_{\text{"TapTweak"}}(x(P_{\text{swap}}) \parallel \text{TapLeaf}(L_{\text{ref}}))$, and $Q_{\text{swap}} = P_{\text{swap}} + t_{\text{tap}} \cdot G$ with BIP-327 accumulated tweak `t_acc` and parity `g_key`. Alice funds `0x51 0x20 || x(Q_swap)`. Let $h_{\text{conf}}$ be confirmation height.
   - **Normative `T_btc_worst`:** Defined explicitly at the `2.0×` June-2021 slow-block multiple: `T_btc_worst = 72 * 600s * 2.0 = 86,400s` (24 hours).
3. **Bob Locks `zBTC` FIRST:** Before Alice releases any partial signature, Bob calls `PtlcContract.Create(expirationTime = T_znn, pointType = 2, pointLock = compress(T), destination = Alice_Addr)` (`dev:vm/embedded/definition/ptlc.go:114-120`) with **`T_znn >= T_btc_worst + 21,600s = 108,000s` (30 hours, `~9,474` Momentums at `11.4s`)**.
4. **Bounded Adaptor Exchange (Anti-Free-Option, `M-4`):** Alice MUST release her BIP-327 adaptor partial signature $\tilde{s}_A$ within **`<= 6` Bitcoin blocks** of Zenon PTLC confirmation (forming $R' = R_A + R_B + T$ with parity $g_R$, $\tilde{s} = \tilde{s}_A + \tilde{s}_B + e \cdot g_{\text{key}} \cdot t_{\text{acc}} \pmod n$); otherwise Bob aborts cleanly before revealing $t$.
5. **Confirmed-Before-Refund Atomic Claim (`M-4` Fixed):** Bob checks that remaining blocks before refund maturity are `>= 18` blocks, completes $s = \tilde{s} + g_R \cdot t \pmod n$, includes a `<pk_B>` CPFP anchor output, and **MUST have his claim tx CONFIRMED at or before `h_conf + 66`** (`6` blocks before Alice's `h_conf + 72` refund leaf matures — NEVER "broadcast before `h_conf + 72`", which enables RBF double-theft!). Alice extracts $t_{\text{ext}} = g_R \cdot (s - \tilde{s}) \bmod n$, verifies $\text{compress}(t_{\text{ext}} \cdot G) == \text{PointLock}$, and calls `PtlcContract.Unlock(ptlcId, t_ext)` (`dev:vm/embedded/implementation/ptlc.go:82-95`).

### 5.2 HTLC Atomic Swaps & Lightning Submarine-Swap Gateway

- **Hash Type:** ALL Bitcoin/Lightning HTLCs MUST pass **`hashType = 1` (`HashTypeSHA256`, `dev:vm/embedded/definition/htlc.go:92`)**.
- **Normative `Δ_safety`:** **`Δ_safety = 36` Bitcoin blocks** (~6h nominal, ~12h at `2.0×` slow blocks).
- **Inbound (`LN → zBTC`) & Channel-Jamming Defense (`M-4`):** User pays Gateway's LN Hold Invoice FIRST; ONLY AFTER Hold Invoice reaches `ACCEPTED` with `CLTV >= now + 2 * Δ_safety` (`72` blocks) does Gateway lock `zBTC` in `HtlcContract` (`T_znn <= T_ln - Δ_safety`). Gateways MUST enforce per-peer Hold Invoice rate limits (`<= 5` concurrent pending hold invoices and `<= 0.10 BTC` concurrent exposure per peer, with a **5-minute cancel TTL** if the user does not progress).
- **Outbound (`zBTC → LN`):** User locks `zBTC` (`hashType = 1`); Gateway pays BOLT-11 invoice (`T_ln <= T_znn - Δ_safety`), learns preimage $r$, unlocks `zBTC`.
- **Stage 0 Conformance Suite (`G-18`):** Signet↔Zenon tests for `>= 72`-block CSV, CPFP claim confirmation by `h_conf + 66`, Alice timeout abort at `+6` blocks, odd-$y(R')$ parity, BIP-327 `PartialSigAgg`, `hashType = 0` rejection, and LN Hold Invoice `ACCEPTED`-first + 5-min cancel TTL.
